estimate.damage_summary: A nearby atmospheric discharge caused an overvoltage event that physically damaged a speaker system and TV connected to the building’s electrical installation. A technician subsequently attended to investigate the surge failure and check wiring safety.
estimate.policy_notes: Overvoltage damage to appliances is covered subject to the EUR 5,000 gross event sub-limit and the no-improvement rule. Because the appliances were not connected through surge protection, indemnity for them is halved; the policy excludes service/arrangement charges and non-repair costs, and attendance is not covered on an invoice without indemnifiable work.

lines.invoice_text: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set)
lines.rationale: Both appliances are reported physically damaged by the insured overvoltage event, and the quantity matches the two listed items. The reasonable amount is for standard replacements corresponding to the pre-loss specification, not upgrades; the missing surge protection halves the otherwise payable indemnity.

lines.invoice_text: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out
lines.rationale: The diagnostic visit relates to the reported event, but the policy’s operative terms exclude the arrangement/order charge and the attendance charge on an invoice without indemnifiable work; diagnosis and a safety check are not themselves repair costs. One visit/report is plausible for the described attendance, rather than three separate service units.
